title: Populations, index dates and study recipes
text: Suppose want adults starting metformin, year observable history, follow myocardial infarction. Concept IDs illustrative: review vocabulary definitions descendants study. simple layer returns ordinary advanced recipe. print() shows choices recipe_to_code() makes reproducible. uses episode grain, relative dates priority ties. Baseline becomes wide output; one outcome becomes survival, multiple outcomes become competing risk (first selected cause, every later event). long uses outcome events; panel counts 30-day bins. outputs require outcomes; baseline requires variables. explicit follow-settings, start day 1, end unbounded, observation end death censor follow-. omop_new_users() indexes drug eras (default gap 30 days), uses interval end episode end, requires washout observed free drug days -365 -1. Giving population omop_study() keeps index criteria adds require. default require$looks index day; no_history_of stops day .
code: library(dsOMOPClient) metformin <- omop_concept_set(1503297, descendants = TRUE) diabetes <- omop_concept_set(201826, descendants = TRUE) mi <- omop_event("condition_occurrence", 432984, descendants = TRUE)  study <- omop_study(   index = omop_new_users(metformin, washout_days = 365,                          select = "first_eligible", by = "ingredient"),   require = list(age = c(18, NA),                  has = list(omop_event("condition_occurrence", diabetes))),   baseline = list(age = omop_age(), sex = omop_sex(),                   visits = omop_count("visit_occurrence", before = 365)),   outcomes = list(mi = mi),   follow_up = list(start = 1, end = 365,                    censor = c("observation_end", "death")),   outputs = c("baseline", "survival"), name = "metformin_study") print(study) recipe_to_code(study)

title: Multi-Server Federated Analysis
text: dsOMOP v2 designed federated analysis across multiple DataSHIELD servers, hosting OMOP CDM database. Servers may differ CDM version, available tables columns, vocabulary version, database engine, disclosure policy data volume. dsOMOP exposes differences runtime introspection negotiates compatible aggregate policies capacity limits. Assigned categories use shared declared factor domains; aggregate age groups retain public-grid rules. Schema comparison make arbitrary heterogeneous plans portable: analyst must still reconcile requested tables, columns, concepts output cardinality execution.

text: Searches vocabulary tables across connected DataSHIELD servers concepts matching given pattern /filters. title: Search for OMOP concepts by name — ds.omop.concept.search
text: pattern Character; search term SQL LIKE pattern match concept names. Supports partial matching (e.g., "diabetes" matches "Type 2 diabetes mellitus"). NULL (default) searches across vocabularies. standard_only Logical; TRUE (default), standard concepts returned. Set FALSE include non-standard classification concepts. Ignored standard supplied. limit Integer; maximum number results return per server (default: 50). NULL (default) applies ID filter. standard Character; explicit standard_concept value filter (e.g. "S" standard, "C" classification). supplied overrides standard_only. NULL (default) applies explicit value filter. valid Logical; TRUE keeps currently-valid concepts (invalid_reason NULL), FALSE invalidated ones. NULL (default) returns . symbol Character; session symbol used OMOP connection initialised (default: "omop"). conns DSI connection object(s). what: Summarise a value column scoped to one concept of one table — ds.omop.concept.summary
title: Summarise a value column scoped to one concept of one table — ds.omop.concept.summary
text: Type-aware orchestrator summarises value column single concept single OMOP CDM table. unit analysis (table, concept_id, column) triple: OMOP value column makes sense within concept (measurement table mixes HbA1c, weight, blood pressure, ...), restricting one concept yields interpretable distribution. Numeric categorical value columns receive different DataSHIELD-safe statistics: *_concept_id value column (e.g.     value_as_concept_id) treated CATEGORICAL summarised     ds.omop.value.counts (disclosure-safe frequency     counts categories observed concept). value_as_number (numeric value column) treated     NUMERIC summarised ds.omop.column.stats     (n, mean, SD, missingness, distinct count)     ds.omop.value.quantiles (median, IQR, percentiles).     Min/max never returned: server clamps quantile probabilities     [0.05, 0.95]. function adds concept_id filter queries already disclosure-gated server-side; existing gates fire concept-filtered population, concept persons blocked.

title: Connect to an OMOP CDM resource on DataSHIELD servers — ds.omop.connect
text: Connection setup --none across requested servers. public handle symbol must absent everywhere, one resource must resolve every node, capabilities plus transient-resource cleanup verified local session recorded. Partial initialization closed removed. Schema arguments passed literal call values, never parsed code. assigning resource, client requires complete AggregateMethods inventory every node. method named c/list, alias targeting base::c/base::list, aborts connection can wrap release unreviewed protected object. safety preflight mandatory even strict = FALSE. connection self-healing: server-side OMOP database connection auto-reconnects demand, dropped timed-database connection transparently re-established next call. therefore need keep session warm periodic pings long idle periods. Use ds.omop.status want manually probe connectivity.
